description.value: The Fairmont Hotel Vancouver is a landmark luxury property in the heart of downtown Vancouver, a grand chateau-style building that has anchored West Georgia Street since 1939. Part of the Fairmont Hotels & Resorts portfolio, it offers upscale accommodations alongside on-site dining, a spa, and fitness facilities. Its central location places touring cyclists within walking distance of the city core, the seawall, and major transit connections.
